LESSON: CALMING THE STORM

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.3: Calming the Storm

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Calming the Storm
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How is God’s power over nature portrayed in calming the storm?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. discuss lessons learnt from the miracle of calming the storm
2. explain challenges faced by Christians today

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: discuss lessons learnt from the miracle of calming the storm

Teach

• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: explain challenges faced by Christians today

SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: discuss lessons learnt from the miracle of calming the storm
• Model 2: explain challenges faced by Christians today

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: discuss lessons learnt from the miracle of calming the storm

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Calming the Storm.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How is God’s power over nature portrayed in calming the storm?

SECTION: REMEMBER
